checklist: A disk whose first directory read is slow (just mounted, asleep; LUMINA_SLOW_DIR_MS stands in for it) must not freeze the app while a folder opens: the access check and the listing run off the main thread. The page asks the app something (lumina.checkAccess) 1.5 s into the open, on its own clock (the probe's runner shares the app's main thread, so it can't time this itself); the answer must come back within a second, not when the slow read ends.

steps.src: window.__ping = null; setTimeout(() => { const t = performance.now(); window.lumina.checkAccess().then(() => { window.__ping = Math.round(performance.now() - t); }); }, 1500); return true

steps.what: the folder read after the slow listing

steps.src: return 'app answered in ' + window.__ping + ' ms while the folder was being listed'

steps.why: the main thread was free during the slow directory read
